As a first-time player of this series, I have never been more captivated by a story and cast of characters in any other video game than I have in this one. Most of the game is paced incredibly well (with some exceptions of the tedious filler missions, but even those have their moments), the combat is fun, the art direction is outstanding and the English voice acting is brilliant.

I came into this game unsure if I would enjoy it, but I was absolutely not disappointed. Can't wait for Rebirth on PC. I highly suggest you play it, although I would wait for a sale because its price is very high when not discounted.
What a great modernization of a classic. I loved every bit of it. It is an experience more than a combat game. Just sit back and let it feel like you're playing a shonen.

got it 50% off because someone on discussion shared his/her greengaming discount. so wait till its on sale dont give those greedy higher ups in SquareEnix the approval of pricing games beyond fair

the game is a very polish modern take on the original settings, music and art style. perfect for me except the full price

this is beautiful game!
oh this is my first time play final fantasy, because the older game had turn-based combat system and that not kinda my type, but oh dang this remake, what a game.

As someone who hasn't played the original FF7, this was a good game. It felt unfinished at the end, which is understandable since this is just part of the FF7 story, but it wasn't like playing the first part of a trilogy. Like for example, playing Mass Effect 1 and finishing it gives a good conclusion and prepares you for what's to come; this game just ends at a point that doesn't feel like a conclusion.

That being said, it is a good game with interesting combat, and quite a bit of over-the-top action sequences that are so silly that it's endearing. Had a fun time with it.

This game is the personification of a heart rate monitor, it goes up and down, up and down, up and down. Some moments I hate it, other moments I love it. But def would play if Rebirth interest you. Also Zach is best girl.
This game has lost all of the fun from exploring and finding secrets. All of the side missions feel like a chore (I usually love side missions). It's like they let Ubisoft take the wheel....

I'd say its a 6.5/10 While fun some of the alterations and skipped content was puzzling, not a remake per say and definitely not a remaster. Some combat functions and interactions along with weapons and materia felt incomplete. 

For what I got I feel it was overpriced and has the looming specter of a potential future PSN requirement potentially limits future replays.

I'm biased with the franchise but that being said, this remake plays very smooth and the frame rate stays locked in very well. I held off on this game trying to wait for the 3rd part to come out on the pc version but....it may still be awhile );

There is so much to be said about this game, but I will try to keep it brief.

Final Fantasy VII is one of the most beloved Square Enix franchises to date. This remake not only resonates with fans of the original, on the original Playstation, but with new players as well. The complete package with the DLC, formally a PS5 exclusive, made it's way to Steam with great rapport.

There is so much hype behind this series for good reason. The story, the setting, the characters, the gameplay, the mechanics, the music, the art, the design, the graphic, everything about this game is made with skill and passion, and it shows.

This game is worth well over the asking price for what you get. It's a fantastic experience, that should not be passed. The replay value is worth it alone. Even if you've never played a Final Fantasy game before, this is the best place to start.

As of the time of writing this review, there are two sequels on the way. They are easily the most anticipated video game releases of our time. The only downside is the next game is releasing as a PS5 exclusive, but will most likely make it's way to Steam in the following year, just as this title did. Nothing major, just try to avoid spoilers. I hear this next one is a doozy.
They really captured the heart of this game into the modern day. i was worried they would blow it and ruin things but im thoroughly enjoying it all so far!
amazing game. great story and gameplay. keeps me involved and always wanting more. some of the sidequest are a little boring but other than that loved it

It has been 6 months since FF7 Remake came to PC on Epic and they still have not added any more graphical options in the menu than with what they initially had on the Epic port. Not only this but they do not support Ultrawide monitor resolutions - which is what I have been running for years. After 6 months I expected this to have been addressed... I was wrong. AND THEY WANT TO CHARGE $70 FOR THIS?

It looks like they attempted to fix the initial problems with the port when it came to Epic and then stopped short. I still have large FPS stutter during cutscenes...

I cannot recommend this until they fix these issues.
New and fresh, The new content in the game makes it seem like a totally new game. Graphics are phenomenal, the characters are more relatable. Thank you to the development team.

While I played the crap out of the Original (probably over 1000 hours easy throughout my younger years), the remake for me seems to be full of fluff/filler content. The combat is fine, the GFX are wicked and everything else looks good. I might just not be a fan of the Midgar ark, but I find it was just too much for me. If people are coming into this fresh, they will likely enjoy it. Just knowing the story, I just hate how its being dragged out so much for a part of the game that usually takes 3-5 hours max to play through on the original.
never played the original and so far im in love with the game i kinda regret not carring for the original but hey this one is fire
Beautiful but hollow. 90% auto attack and 10% cut scenes. Watch the game play online or get it on sale.

A must-play. The core game remains a hybrid of real-time action and strategic command-based combat, which feels fluid and satisfying. FFVII remake elevates the original remake with technical polish and a fun side story.

I have not played the original to be honest but I absolutely loved every minute of this remake. I can only imagine how nostalgic and exciting it must feel for players who have played the original. The gameplay, the graphics, the story, all are very well crafted.

Sephiroth boss fight is one of the best boss battles I've ever played, hands down. And of course, Cloud and Tifa are my favorites.

This game provided a great foundation for future FF projects. It showcased how great the materia system was and brought back the original ATB gauge. Nevertheless, the story is somewhat decent, as it dives deeper into minor characters' arcs, like Wedge, Biggs, and Jessie. Remake is extremely linear, covering only about 20% of the original FF7, so I can't really complain about that. The combat system is fantastic—I love how Square blended free-roam combat with turn-based RPG elements, which reminds me of the Mass Effect series. "But as a remake, it should have remained faithful to the original turn-based format, just as P3R stayed true to the PS2 version.
7,5/10
P/s: this game's narrative is extremely odd as it introduced sephiroth, it doesnt matter for ogs but for newcomers its really confusing for them to figure out who main antagonist is without research

Game is fun. A nice mix of action and strategic combat.

Only con is that the game is padded with boring content to justify a trilogy remake. Because of this pacing is inferior to the original.

I recommend playing through the main story line, ignoring side content, then going back through each chapter if you like the core gameplay loop enough.

Game is a solid 8/10
Awesome game. I played it when it 1st came out on Playstation, but I wanted to play the dlc, so I got it on steam.

ff7 was my first RPG I had as a kid, and this remake brought back a lot of nostalgia, but it also fell short a little. after the first "stage", the theme songs really start to deviate from the original and they made them kinda bad. The awesome sewer music is gone, the fight music is modified way to much and is not entertaining anymore... A lot of sidequests for new weapons or materia or whatever are just boring "go all the way out there, slap some monsters and then come back to deliver the item" kinda quests with boring NPCs that have no impact on the game narative whatsoever.
I went back to play the original after finishing this one, and honestly, the original is just so much better in every aspect except the graphics and such are old and square and pixely. But that's probably because of nostalgia and the expectation given to this game.
If you never touched the original ff7, you might think this game is the best ff7 once you try both.

It's a great change of pace from modern open world games tbh
Playing something linear with the right mix of gameplay and great cutscenes

Feels like playing a anime

🎭 FF7 Remake is the video game equivalent of watching 1000 One Piece/Naruto filler episodes to get to the good stuff. Its definitely a competent game. Audio/visually its undeniably great. Really cinematic, both in good and bad ways. The combat is okay, but quite easy. You get plenty of items and checkpoints everywhere, making it possible to ignore many of the game mechanics altogether

⏳ Hard difficulty is unlocked only after beating the game, and thats a shame because I doubt many people will replay it after fighting through 40 hours of padded-out content. Its a great example of why its better to have a shorter game that leaves you wanting more than a long game that makes you want it to finally end faster. Especially considering that this section of the original FF7 was only about 4 hours long

👍 That said, I still finished it, as theres plenty of good stuff to carry you through (especially if you are nostalgic for the original). I would give it a mixed review if I could. I would have given it a great review if it were two times shorter and a bit more challenging

Best game ever made, also Tifa... omg. She is fictional unfortunately, real women are not that... and even if they were, be realistic... try to remember that if you play when male. Also the soundtrack is mesmerizing, although cannot be bought for some reason... That is a shame, because the original soundtrack already was great and they managed to make it better.

They really put some love into this world and the soundtrack especially. You can easily see that the main question the devs asked themselves was: "Can we improve and modernize a near perfect game". I daresay they succeeded, without losing the essence of what made it good in the first place. And i can't say it enough, developers should pay attention to this soundtrack and the seamless flow between action and exploration, it can make a game exceptional for those whom play for adventure and story!

It's an amazing game, if you loved the original one, you will be astounded and delighted to see that world from a first person perspective. The sheer amount of creativity and respect that went into bringing ff7 to live is just humbling. It makes me hope for a an IX remake and an VIII remake, remake them all and i will buy them all... just... put as much love into them as you did here.
Had to finish 95% of this game and it is still good, hope you like it too, though it does not seem so, this game requires A LOT of skills and strats but it's pretty good

Amazing Game - great graphics and cutscenes, interesting story, super fun combat.
Had a great time exploring the maps and getting the game to 100%
Can't wait for the sequel.
Some nice nods to the original, but nice changes along with the graphics upgrades. The battles are super fun and intense, I really like it!

Absolutely incredible.

It took me a while to get round to giving this one a chance as I was more of a FF8 girlie and was concerned that the only reason this was getting any hype is because FF7 fans are just kinda, like that...but no, this takes what was a flawed game with an interesting story and expands it out, giving setpieces and character moments the room to breathe that was missing in comparable scenes in the original.

If this was just an upgrade to the story and nothing else I'd probably be satisfied, but the battles are the most tense and exciting RPG gameplay I've had in a minute, and elevate this beyond nostalgia bait and into straight up frothing at the mouth cant-stop-thinking-about-it obsession.

Also yes the soundtrack is BANGIN'

An excellent remake of the original, I wasn't too excited about the new combat system, and I had some apprehensions about the story for fear it would be too modified, and honestly, I was quite surprised by the quality of this remake.

- The fights are super intense and satisfying.

- The story is really enjoyable to do.

- The characters are still just as charismatic.

- Platinum is cool

8.5/10 in my opinion

superb game, an in more depth version of the original with added story and content. Love the original, and this is an outstanding recreation that tells a 1/3 of the story of the original. Epic, amazing visual and story, music is superb. Highly recommend

The boss fights are so bad. They keep putting stupid mid fight cutscenes that are completely unskippable and eat your actions.
Using a limit break? Mid fight cutscene
Finally got a stagger? Mid fight cutscene
Using a move that costs 2 bars? You'll never guess

Its a microcosm of the game as a whole. There's a lot to love but the game can't stop tripping over itself to show you 'cool moments of spectacle' that rip your agency away to its own detriment.

Let me play the game. Stop taking control away from me every five seconds.

As far as the story goes, there was a lot added that really fleshes out the world and characters, and a lot that is just blatant padding that slows the pace of the game to a crawl.

Time will tell how good the story ends up being, but as a standalone experience it's damn good. Imo it's most remarkable for how well it adapts turn-based combat mechanics to real-time gameplay.

edit: I should probably mention this is a sequel to the original FF7. "Remake" is a play on words relating to the antagonist's plan. There's a sizable chunk of people who've played both games and still can't seem to put that together. Just know what you're buying, I guess?
the battle system feels great and exploring midgar is truly a treat as a long time FF fan.
It's my first time playing FF7, I'm really enjoying this! The story is fun, the combat is fun, the music is great, the visuals are amazing.

Man i love this game, still wish that they maybe made it like the OG with random encounters, and released as one big game that continues your progress over to the next game, ie discs. The one thing i enjoyed most about the OG other than the music and story, was the grind to build your characters, and exploring the world to find secrets rather than the linear game play it is now. BUT, i do appreciate the REMAKE for what it is, it still a very special game, to someone who played it back in 97. i had it on epic but bought it again on steam, i just like all my games in one place when possible lol.

Love it! this is such a fun and amazing Final fantasy game! and cloud is the best final fantasy character ever
He's awesome and a cool dude!

This is my first final fantasy game I've played and wow. I was expecting to do a lot of grinding and have to adapt to a lot of JRPG systems but honestly this game was just too good. This game is basically perfectly paced. There might be a few times I can think of that felt only slightly slow or drawn out but barely. I was expecting a weirdly adapted turn based combat system in the form of a real time combat system with clunkily added JRPG elements. But nope, this combat system is just way too cool and feels way too good. Even bosses that I expected to be damage sponges were perfectly long enough.

Gosh, the story at times was like watching a really good show. The music is siiimply divine. It had all the up and downs and totally made me feel things bro. Also the graphics look better than real life, and I'm playing at 1080p with a 1070. This is definitely a 10/10 game.

Fnal Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade

A story about a soldier and the friends he makes, drawn into a 'save the earth' type battle; fighting impossible odds against a massive and evil corporation. Funny, sweet and tragic at times, the game is linear and cinematic.

My Likes

Beautiful Graphics and lovely textures for face and hair
Moves at a good pace
Not too many side quests
Characters are sweet and lovable

Puzzles-Hate Puzzles

Doesnt feel like an RPG but is a beautiful and compelling game, just not one that ticks ALL my boxes. For this reason I wouldnt recommend it for €80, I think they are pushing it a bit there. I think get it on sale, its definitely worth 50-60 euro.
veli Goog, i like the storyline, characters communication especially each character has their own character's personality. Suggest to have a try if you like FF series
Stunning realisation of the world of FF7. Great game with fantastic additions to the originals world.

Fun and nostalgic. The port isn't the best, some of the additional characters are weird, but overall, 8.8/10. Maintains the same sort of charm and vibe as the original, the battle system is well-tuned and engaging, it's hard to put down once you are on a roll. Almost feels like an extension of FF13 in how the graphics and battle system are handled, and it works well.
The game is really fun—I’ve been enjoying it a lot. I love Cloud as a character, and Tifa too!

I haven't had this much fun playing a final fantasy game in ages. it has just the right amount of old while being new with what we loved its great ive had a huge smile on my face the entire time playing it.
dis game is gas, the hand massage lady is the baddest bit i have ever seen!

I love this series, and it’s my favorite Final Fantasy game. The story is wonderful. Walking around, seeing the people and the environments, with that music playing, makes me feel relaxed and makes the world feel alive. I’m so excited for the next part of FFVII! 🔥

I also really enjoy the side quests, and I’ve almost completed all of them. My favorite has to be Fort Condor—I ended up spending way more time on that board game than I expected!

Great game for someone who hasn't played the original, and even better for someone who has.

Combat system made some fights more annoying than challenging, and found some side-missions a bit tedious. However, overall I found it to be a really fun remake of my favourite game and I look forward to playing the next instalment when it (finally) releases on PC.

Please DO NOT buy for £70!

Generally, it's well-balanced. But this is the only first chapter of the FF7 remake trilogy. Neither FF7 REMAKE tells a complete story, nor the consequent chapter offers a smooth experience. Don't purchase too early before you are convinced the last chapter is good enough to cure the torture of FF7-2 REBIRTH: Ceaseless Interruption of Minigames.

A great game but this and Rebirth and whatever the 3rd one will be called are NOT substitutes for the original despite what the marketing may say. If you truly want to get into and experience the world of ff7, play the original first and then onto these. Despite years of fans begging, there still isn't a true substitute for the original, If you can't handle the original's crunchiness you can atleast mod it pretty good.

tldr.text: Very Positive (86%): players love the story and characters, and 56% of reviews praise them.
The biggest complaints are the story and the combat, with some calling the world boring and the fights repetitive.

details.text: In recent reviews, complaints have eased across the board, with story complaints down to 16% from 21% overall.
Players who review in their opening hours are far less positive, at 64%, than those who have played longer.
